Subject: Dedicated capacity demo — throughput/latency needs

Hi Hannah,

We signed up through the self-serve flow and this morning an SDR asked me to reach out to set up a dedicated-capacity-focused demo. Our use case is latency-sensitive inference for a customer-facing chat product. High-level requirements:~
- Peak concurrent sessions: ~120 sessions
- Typical request size: 120–220 tokens, average 150 tokens
- Daily volume: ~3M tokens (spiky, ~3x in PST mornings)
- Goal p95 latency: < 150ms on our SLA-sensitive endpoints

We'd like a short technical demo of Redwood Dedicated to see whether throughput/latency targets are achievable and how autoscaling and rollout policies would work for us.

I've attached a small sample of our traffic (anonymized) to help with sizing. Can we get a 45-min slot next week? Prefer mornings PST.

Attachment: prod_traffic_sample.csv (CSV, 42 KB)

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Head of Infrastructure | Wavelength.ai

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Jordan — thanks for the sample and the ask. A few technical clarifications that will help us tailor the demo:~
1) Model: please confirm name/version (we need to know whether it's an LLM we host for you or a model from our catalog).
2) Concurrency pattern: are the ~120 concurrent sessions steady or bursty? If bursty, what's the typical burst multiplier and duration?
3) Tokenization and max tokens per request (we need the tokenization for memory + KV sizing).
4) Desired p50/p95/p99 latency SLOs and whether soft-fail (graceful fallback) is acceptable during overload.
5) Are you planning to use streaming responses or full-response generation only? Streaming affects latency profiling.

For the demo itself, here's what we propose: a short infra diagram, then a perf-run against a dedicated pool in our staging environment using your sample traffic (non-prod keys). We'll show p50/p95 results, autoscale behavior with a controlled ramp, and fallback policy behavior.

If you can confirm the model family and approximate token sizes, I can pre-configure a candidate pool and bring internal test harnesses to the demo. Suggested slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-09-29 09:30–10:15 (works for me)
- Thu 2026-10-01 08:30–09:15

I'll attach our internal intake checklist for your review.

Attachment: dedicated-demo-ops-checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Hannah and Aditya — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Model is a custom fine-tuned 13B variant (transformer, proprietary weights) we plan to host ourselves initially; we'll want Redwood to run inference against our model artifacts (BYOM). Sequence lengths hover between 100–320 tokens with tail cases to 512. Bursts are typically 3–5x lasting 3–7 minutes when new content publishes. Streaming is used in our chat UI.

Adding Samir (infra) — he'll be our SRE lead for the session. Of the proposed times, Tue 09:30 PST works but can we shift to 10:00–10:45 PST? Samir has a conflict at 09:30.

Also, Samir will upload a slightly larger anonymized traffic file after the holiday; I can share it before the demo.

Cheers,
Jordan
